delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone as frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing against the guards holding the choke point tight. Nearby, a gate serjeant keeps a sharp eye on the roster board while managing the anxious crowd. A notice board lists new taxes, imposed curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol, drawing furtive glances from passersby. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, their eyes shifting uneasily. A tavern runner loudly trades hot stew and whispered rumors near a rain barrel, cutting through the damp air. Overlooking the square, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors, standing in quiet contrast to the clamorous, muddy scene below. Just beyond, Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point, worsening the crowd's congestion. One figure in threadbare clothes stands unnervingly still, watching faces and pack animals more than the gate line itself.
